subject.title: CI/CD: Refactor complex workflow matrices into reusable workflows and JSON configs

question: Should OpenClaw decompose the main CI workflow into reusable workflows and static JSON matrix configs, or keep the current dynamic planner-owned model and refactor only narrower stable pieces?
rationale: The request is valid maintainability work, but the CI graph controls release gates, runner-registration budget, and check coverage, so automation should not choose the architecture boundary alone.

options.title: Sponsor a staged CI decomposition
options.body: Choose stable extraction boundaries, preserve dynamic planner outputs where needed, and require docs, guard tests, workflow sanity, and exact-head PR CI proof before landing.

options.title: Keep the dynamic planner model
options.body: Close or narrow the request to smaller maintainability patches around the existing `preflight` and planner structure instead of pursuing JSON workflow matrices.

options.title: Split the umbrella into narrower issues
options.body: Keep this as context but create focused follow-ups for matrix planning, reusable workflow extraction, and workflow documentation so each can be reviewed independently.

recommendation.title: Sponsor a staged CI decomposition
recommendation.body: Choose stable extraction boundaries, preserve dynamic planner outputs where needed, and require docs, guard tests, workflow sanity, and exact-head PR CI proof before landing.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent CI capacity and guard-test work makes this the best available owner signal for choosing a safe decomposition boundary.
